model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the average percentages of three variables across three time periods. The horizontal axis represents the time periods, labeled "2000er Jahre," "2010er Jahre," and "2020er Jahre." The vertical axis is labeled "Durchschnitt in %" and displays values ranging from -2.0 to 6.0, with tick labels at intervals of 1.0. Three sets of bars are presented for each time period, each representing a different variable: "Welt-BIP" (green), "Exportierte Deutschland" (blue), and "Industrieproduktion Deutschland" (light blue). For the "2000er Jahre" period, the "Welt-BIP" bar has an approximate value of 3.9, the "Exportierte Deutschland" bar has a value of 1.0, and the "Industrieproduktion Deutschland" bar has a value of -1.5. In the "2010er Jahre" period, the "Welt-BIP" bar has an approximate value of 5.3, the "Exportierte Deutschland" bar has a value of 4.8, and the "Industrieproduktion Deutschland" bar has a value of 2.2. Finally, in the "2020er Jahre" period, the "Welt-BIP" bar has an approximate value of 3.7, the "Exportierte Deutschland" bar has a value of 2.3, and the "Industrieproduktion Deutschland" bar has a value of 0.4. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
